name: Dolma
description: Dolma is a large English-language corpus for language-model pretraining research, comprising approximately three trillion tokens from a mixture of web content, academic publications, code, books, social media, and encyclopedic materials. This record is loader-only and does not distribute dataset files.
citation: Soldaini, L., Kinney, R., Bhagia, A., Schwenk, D., Atkinson, D., Authur, R., et al. (2024). Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research. arXiv:2402.00159. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2402.00159
